facts.fact: 叙述者抵达车祸现场时，现场已经聚了一圈围观者
facts.anchor: There’s already a crowd at the accident site when I arrive.

facts.fact: 叙述者对围观者感到烦躁——人总忍不住要凑近看车祸
facts.anchor: People never can resist seeing a car accident up close. Always annoying.

facts.fact: 叙述者自称站在西班牙流感前线，那时要每周给大批新入职的 Reaper 做培训
facts.anchor: I was on the front lines of the Spanish influenza, a time when so many new Reapers had to be pressed into service that we held orientations every week.

facts.fact: 训练要求他们对这类现场保持冷漠无情
facts.anchor: We are trained to handle scenes like the one before me dispassionately.

facts.fact: 他说比本该有的自然寿命早很多就死，总是难办的
facts.anchor: people dying decades before what should have been their natural end is always hard.

facts.fact: Lucy McKenzie 死时比叙述者自己当年死时更年轻，她的死被称作悲剧，他的死不是
facts.anchor: Lucy McKenzie is—was—even younger than I had been when I died. Her death—unlike mine—is a tragedy.

facts.fact: 他说要不是那辆公交车她本可以活到很老，并注明这是上级派下卷宗时告诉他的
facts.anchor: If it weren’t for this bus, she would have lived to a very old age. Or so my supervisor told me when they assigned me her file.

facts.fact: 她的灵魂亮得惊人，像万花筒，他能在任何地方找到它
facts.anchor: Ms. McKenzie’s soul is so brilliant I could have found her anywhere. Not just a bright flash against the gloom, but more like a kaleidoscope with all its swirling colors.

facts.fact: 他自称专业的死亡代理人，把周围围观者称为看热闹的蠢货
facts.anchor: I am a professional agent of death, not a gawking bystander like the idiots all around us.

facts.fact: 她的灵魂挣扎着抵抗他的牵引，因为一切构成她的东西都紧抓不放
facts.anchor: She fights against my intrusion the way people always do when they die this suddenly and this young.

facts.fact: 他看见她的生前记忆：深爱的姐姐、多年前丢下的速写本、快乐的家族旅行、挥之不去的终生内疚
facts.anchor: I see a sister she adores. A sketchbook she used to carry everywhere but abandoned years ago. Happy family vacations to a familiar mountain town. A nearly overwhelming lifelong sense of guilt.

facts.fact: 他承认自己这次没能移开视线
facts.anchor: This time, however—despite my best efforts—I can’t look away.

facts.fact: 最后他闭着眼睛，温和地劝她放手
facts.anchor: I close my eyes when I urge her, gently, to let go.
